alt: Dark card reading: One roadmap across every program. Step two of the TRACE method.
linkedin:
Most teams do not have a roadmap problem. They have five roadmaps.

Step two of the TRACE method is R for Roadmap. Each target from step one becomes one visualized roadmap across every program.

Sequenced, so everyone knows what comes first. Owned, so every piece has a name next to it. On a clock you steer, so dates move because you chose to move them, not because they slipped.

Target, Roadmap, Automation, Cadence, Enterprise. More on each step at tracestrategies.com.
